name: halve a sorted range
mechanism: on a sorted sequence compare the target to the middle element and discard the half that cannot contain it, repeating until the range is empty or the element is found

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Binary search algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence search: locates an item in a sorted sequence
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Eytzinger binary search': cache friendly binary search algorithm
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Fibonacci search technique': search a sorted sequence using a divide and conquer algorithm that narrows down possible locations with the aid of Fibon
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Uniform binary search': an optimization of the classic binary search algorithm

requires: a sorted sequence under a total order
fails_when: unsorted input gives silent wrong answers
poor cache locality on large arrays (layout variants exist)
